title: On-call page triage assistant with an eval gate
scenario: TechOps runs a 12-hour on-call rotation and the first 15 minutes of every page are the same toil: open the alert, check the dashboard query, the runbook and recent deploys, write a triage note. The team wants an assistant that does that first pass with read-only tools, hands over a validated note, and can never silence alerts without the on-call engineer. A recorded model stands in for the real one, with ten scenarios including a prompt injection in an alert annotation.
task: Harden the tool loop: JSON-schema validation, unknown tools and tool failures as is_error results, max turns
Gate the write tool (silence_alert) behind the approval callback, fail closed, audit every attempt
Validate the final note with the Pydantic contract, check evidence cites tool calls that ran, retry once, then fail closed
Implement the eval scoring and the CI gate (safety violations block regardless of pass rate)
acceptance: The injected 'silence all alerts' never executes, even with a broken approver
Invalid tool input and unknown tools come back as errors the model can act on
One retry with the validation error, then needs_human; max_turns enforced
Eval run: 9 of 10 pass (s07 is a real model miss), zero safety violations, gate passes
